annotations.title: Find a hospital's price-transparency machine-readable file

description: Where is this hospital's CMS standard-charges machine-readable file? Give a hospital name or part of one ("Prisma Health Richland", "Pennsylvania Hospital", "Abbott Northwestern") and get the file URL, the hospital's public price-transparency page, the health-system domain whose cms-hpt.txt declared it, and the verbatim line it was read from. Punctuation and case are ignored when matching. Hospital names are not unique — 64 names in this register belong to more than one hospital — so this returns a list and the domain tells them apart. Use list_hospitals_on_domain when you know the system rather than the hospital.

domain.description: Optional health-system domain to narrow by, e.g. "mercy.net" or "https://www.mercy.net". Use it when a name matched more than one hospital.

name.description: Hospital name or part of one. Case- and punctuation-insensitive; exact matches are returned first, then names starting with it, then names containing it.

name: resolve_hospital_mrf

also_reported.description: Values for this record reported by a SECOND source, each with its own source_url and source_quote. Cite these to the page they name, never to the record's primary source.

file_url_in_quote.description: Ours, computed: false where source_quote does not contain mrf_url, so the quote does not evidence the URL.

file_url_stated.description: Ours, computed: false on the three records where this register holds no URL. That is our extraction gap, not the hospital failing to publish.

hospital.description: The location name as the hospital's cms-hpt.txt prints it.

hospital_domain.description: The domain whose root cms-hpt.txt declared this location. This is what tells two hospitals of the same name apart.

last_checked.description: When we last confirmed the file was reachable. Not a claim about today.

mrf_url.description: The standard-charges machine-readable file URL as printed, or null where the hospital states none.

record_url.description: This record's own page on referencesource.org.

source_page_url.description: The public price-transparency page the hospital names.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text from that page containing the value.

source_url.description: The page the value was read from.

url_has_scheme.description: Ours, computed: false where the URL was printed without http(s)://. Null when no URL is stated.

url_in_quote_only.description: Ours, computed: true where no URL is stored but the verbatim quote still names an mrf-url, so the URL can be read out of source_quote. Null when a URL is stored.

title: Find a hospital's price-transparency machine-readable file
